## 📚 Course Materials

**Required:**  
*(Kutner)* Kutner, Nachtsheim & Neter, *Applied Linear Regression Models*, 4th edition (older editions are fine). 
- Data sets and solution manual are available.

**Sub-text:**  
*(Sheather)* Simon J. Sheather (2009), *A Modern Approach to Regression with R* — available online through the UofT library.

## 💻 Computational Tools

All computation in this course is performed in **R**. 

**Cheat Sheets:**
- [R Markdown Cheat Sheet](https://www.rstudio.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/rmarkdown-cheatsheet.pdf)
- [ggplot2 Cheat Sheet](https://www.maths.usyd.edu.au/u/UG/SM/STAT3022/r/current/Misc/data-visualization-2.1.pdf)
